system.description:
Range 10ft; one corpse; cast at night only.

  • Raises an undead of your CL: CL 11-13 a ghoul or shadow; 14-15 a ghast or wight; 16+ a wraith.
  • It obeys you permanently; you can control undead with total HD up to twice your level, and any beyond that are hostile.
  • A Necromancer's undead use Undead Mastery and Soul Tax instead.
  • Material: a black onyx worth 50 gp per HD of the undead, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Necromancer
